readout_other: 32-channel EEG, power spectral density, phase lag index and network metrics; H&E staining
direction_notes: Both pulsed-wave and continuous-wave sonication reduced EEG power spectral density and brain network connection strength in KA-treated rats, with no difference between modes.
safety_notes: No obvious adverse reaction was observed in rats over 24 h; H&E sections showed no tissue damage or immune cell infiltration.

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed wave: 0.5 MHz, 150 cycles per pulse, PRF 1.5 kHz; continuous wave: 0.5 MHz. Both were applied for 40 s after 60 s of epileptic EEG, followed by 60 s of recording.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Two rats received LIPUS and LICUS, respectively, and one rat received no operations.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: We used immersion-type US transducers with a 0.5 MHz center frequency (35 mm focal depth, 20 mm in diameter; Goworld, Guangdong, China) to produce ultrasound waveforms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: We used immersion-type US transducers with a 0.5 MHz center frequency (35 mm focal depth, 20 mm in diameter; Goworld, Guangdong, China) to produce ultrasound waveforms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: As shown in Figure 1, the Af, c.p.p, and PRF of pulsed ultrasound were 0.5 MHz, 150, and 1.5 kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: As shown in Figure 1, the Af, c.p.p, and PRF of pulsed ultrasound were 0.5 MHz, 150, and 1.5 kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The ultrasound stimulation time of these two modes was 40 s.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: The maximum ultrasound pressure of both pulsed and continuous ultrasound was 0.657 MPa.

flags.reason: Not stated; 0.3 ms derived from 150 cycles per pulse at 0.5 MHz (cycles per pulse divided by frequency). Pulsed wave only.
Maximum pressure 0.657 MPa for both modes, measured with a hydrophone; the paper does not say whether this is free field or through skull.

27 rats in total, of which 24 were assigned to groups of 8 and 3 were used for histology (two sonicated, one untouched). The group descriptions are internally confusing (two different 'control' groups).
The stimulation site is given only as coordinates (ML 3 mm, AP -4.5 mm, DV 3 mm); no region is named.
Isoflurane is described for electrode surgery; anaesthetic state during sonication is not stated.
Two modes (pulsed and continuous) at the same target and frequency are recorded as one exposure.
